title: Epipelagic Theta Hypotheses C1-C4
body_html:
Epipelagic Theta Hypotheses C1-C4

The epipelagic theta theorem is stated under four hypotheses:

  • (C1) the type I dual pair is one of the rank-compatible pairs \[ (D_n,C_n),\quad (C_n,D_{n+1}),\quad (C_n,B_n),\quad (A_n,A_n),\quad (A_n,A_{n+1}); \]

  • (C2) the points \(x\in B(G,k)\) and \(x'\in B(G',k)\) are epipelagic points of the same order \(m\ge2\), with corresponding lattice functions \(L,L'\);

  • (C3) the tensor-product lattice function \(B=L\otimes L'\) has jumps in \[ \frac1{2m}+\frac1m\mathbb Z; \]

  • (C4) there exists \[ \bar w\in X=B_{-1/(2m)}/B_{1/(2m)} \] such that the residual moment maps satisfy \[ M(\bar w)=\lambda,\qquad -M'(\bar w)=\lambda', \] where \(\lambda\) and \(\lambda'\) are stable vectors in the corresponding epipelagic graded pieces.
